question: Does trained TimesFM hidden improve Bolt fusion-response prediction beyond both random families under matched local FIT?
evidence_class: Prospectively frozen conditional synthetic predictive feature-efficiency comparison; extrapolation and correctness are separate descriptive axes.

design.status: PREPARED; HOLD NATIVE until a NEW slot grant for this protocol
design.namespace: 4962000..4962051;4954000 namespace belongs to Carson and is not used
design.omitted_fit: First4 FIT sources omit shifted_balanced from fitting only; capture all260 rows. The omitted4 FIT rows are not TEST or used for selection.

primary.aggregate: Within each of32 TEST seeds average all5 conditions equally, then average sources equally.
primary.random_arms: input+Aforecast+random: RFF and ReLU-MLP, each average squared loss over all3 frozen initialization seeds; no best seed/family selection and no prediction ensemble.
primary.required: BOTH random-minus-trained paired-source intervals must have lower>0 AND trained mean loss must be>=5% lower than EACH random-family mean loss.
primary.relative_denominator: Each random-family mean loss; zero denominator is not scorable and cannot pass.
primary.no_rescue: A pass in one family, a descriptive condition, a frozen-extrapolation arm, or a forecast control cannot rescue failure of this primary.

axes.local_FIT: Recompute preprocessing and fit readouts on exactly20 newFIT sources/96 rows; four whole-source folds choose only added rank/alpha. NewTEST labels never enter fitting.
axes.frozen_extrapolation: Apply original oldFIT frozen trained/random coefficients and preprocessing support without updates; summarize ALL and each condition on the same32 new TEST sources. Descriptive axis, no success claim or tuning.
axes.controls: Forecast targets Bolt->TimesFM and TimesFM->Bolt are descriptive controls. Local input-only and fixed input+Aforecast baseline are retained.

design.local_fixed_base: Source model Aforecast values are native outputs, not a trainable model. Input+Aforecast kernel recipe is fixed to prior selected choices (rbf2.0+pca16 for forecast, rbf0.5+pca16 for fusion response). Refit centers/PCA/support on localFIT only. Baseline ridge alpha remains0.001. All learned/random additions use equal block weight1/3.
design.maps: Identical frozen random_features implementation from4953000: full normalized128 history plus2 normalizer values, FIT standardization; RFF gamma1/median distance or untrained affine/ReLU; same widths. Readout budget matched, not pretraining FLOPs/parameters.
design.normalization: Identical history mean/SD targets and inverse for all arms. No physical-scale disadvantage to hidden baselines.
design.behavior: Report source means/CIs by ALL and condition for normalized response energy, exact-zero response fraction, tree eligibility, native/fused true-future MSE, gain, and correction dot. Verify gain=2*dot-energy. Emulating a response does not establish its correctness or semantic equivalence.
design.alignment_null: Omitted from this bounded primary; optional future reuse-only alignment audit cannot change the frozen primary decision.

capture.normalization: Original native baseline; fusion leaves/zero use original full-context native normalizer and matching inverse.
capture.fusion: First block; depth1; equal leaf weights; affine zero correction; pure blend1. No random edits, deeper trees, stability sweeps, or other native endpoints. Tree abstention yields exact native forecast.

design.gates: Exact repeat, full-context locked-normalizer identity, first-block self patch and half-depth self patch on every row; input leaf closure <=2e-6 relative max(1,maxabs(history)). Native cuts/shapes/checkpoint hashes must match.
design.natural_leg: NONE; no natural-context expansion authorized or prepared.
design.evidence: Prospectively frozen synthetic predictive feature-efficiency comparison; no causal or equivalent-semantics claim, no information beyond deterministic full input.

limitations: Local and extrapolation estimands remain separate

exact_findings.evidence_class: Post-hoc descriptive saved-data sensitivity; no selection, refitting or primary revision
exact_findings.denominator: Primary is ratio of source-mean loss difference to source-mean random loss; never mean per-row ratios. All arms use identical history variance. Energy ratios here divide by aggregate energy, not tiny individual responses.
exact_findings.budget_caveat: Same 20 sources/96 rows, widths, rank grid and eight choices per added arm; each random family averages three separately selected losses, not an ensemble prediction. Equal grids need not yield equal effective degrees of freedom. No matched pretraining architecture/compute; intervals condition on this FIT sample and three fixed random maps.
alternative_explanations: Task-conditioned learned feature geometry or regularization can improve finite-sample prediction without adding information beyond deterministic full inputs.
The five-condition mixture and history-variance weighting affect the estimand; leave-condition-out and physical-unit results are descriptive sensitivity checks, not new primary tests.
Only two random-map families and three initializations were tested; architecture, pretraining data/compute, retained variance and effective complexity are not matched.
The fixed base recipe and small localFIT sample can favor particular features; conditional TEST intervals omit training-set and initialization-distribution uncertainty.
Weak frozen transfer and harmful anchor fusion limit claims of generalization or correct semantics. Prediction does not establish cross-model causal equivalence.
